findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker could inject malicious input that, when converted to an integer, could lead to unintended behavior or system compromise.
findings.assumptions: The payload is attacker-controlled and could be crafted to exploit the atoi function in a way that leads to OS command injection.

findings.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
findings.trigger: An attacker could provide a payload that, when converted to an integer, causes an overflow or wraparound, leading to undefined behavior.
findings.assumptions: The payload is attacker-controlled and could be crafted to exploit the atoi function in a way that leads to integer overflow or wraparound.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: An attacker could provide a payload that, when converted to an integer, causes a buffer overflow if the payload is too large.
findings.assumptions: The payload is attacker-controlled and could be crafted to exploit the atoi function in a way that leads to buffer overflow.
